response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) AS ratio, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_averages) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS mean_avg_pic, AVG(p.ratio) AS mean_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - o.avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio_excess FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio;
